managed_daemon.reason: The managed standalone installation required by daemon start is absent. The existing D npm CLI was preserved.

detached_bootstrap.reason: The detached bootstrap did not initialize within its bounded startup window; no successful delivery was inferred.

recovery.procedure: Keep a directly launched documented local listener in its returned process session; discover its actual loopback listener from the matching owned process; initialize a read-only client.
recovery.scope: Service health only; target lookup, current guards, accepted delivery and successor execution remain terminal work.

origin_boundary: Official documentation states Origin-bearing health requests are refused; this is an experimental localhost service, not a remotely exposed production endpoint.
